firms.name: FTMO
firms.notes: No time limit on challenges. Daily loss measured from midnight CET including floating losses. 1-step has a 50% best-day consistency rule; 2-step does not.

firms.name: Apex Trader Funding
firms.notes: Trailing drawdown follows your peak equity including unrealised gains. No daily loss limit during evaluation. 30% consistency rule applies on funded accounts only.

firms.name: MyFundedFutures
firms.notes: EOD drawdown — floor recalculates at market close each day, not intraday. No daily loss limit. 40% consistency rule applies on Core funded accounts.

firms.name: FundedNext
firms.notes: Futures accounts have no daily loss limit. CFD accounts have 5% DLL. Consistency rule (40%) applies to funded Futures accounts only.

firms.name: Topstep
firms.notes: Figures shown are for the 50K Trading Combine. The Max Loss Limit trails your highest end-of-day balance and locks once it reaches your starting balance. The daily loss limit is a soft breach (auto-liquidation), not an instant fail.

firms.name: The5ers
firms.notes: Figures shown are for the High Stakes program; daily drawdown is measured from the prior day closing balance. Newer 1-step CFD plans (Hyper/Pro Growth) use 3% daily / 6% max, and the Futures track adds a 30% best-trade consistency rule.

firms.name: FXIFY
firms.notes: Figures shown are for the Two-Phase Standard challenge, whose max drawdown trails your balance. One-Phase and Lightning models use 3% daily / 4-6% max and add a 30% consistency rule.

firms.name: E8 Funding
firms.notes: Figures shown are for the E8 Classic forex evaluation. Daily drawdown is configurable (3-9.2%) on some models. A best-day consistency rule (40%, or 35% on Signature) applies on funded accounts.

firms.name: FundingPips
firms.notes: Figures shown are for the 2-Step Standard challenge. 1-Step and Pro models use 3% daily / 6% max. A 35% consistency rule applies only on Master on-demand payouts, not during evaluation.

firms.name: Tradeify
firms.notes: Figures shown are representative of the 50K Growth/Select accounts. Drawdown is End-of-Day trailing (recalculates at the close) but is enforced in real time. Lightning accounts have no daily loss limit.

firms.name: Alpha Capital
firms.notes: Figures shown are for Alpha One (1-step). Alpha Pro plans use 3-5% daily and 6-10% static max with a 3-day minimum. The 40% best-day rule applies to on-demand payouts.

firms.name: Goat Funded Trader
firms.notes: Figures shown are for the 2-Step Standard challenge. The 2-Step GOAT model uses 4% daily and adds a 15% payout consistency rule. Instant Funding models close the account if floating PnL drops below -2%.

firms.name: Take Profit Trader
firms.notes: Figures shown are for the 50K evaluation (Test account). Drawdown is End-of-Day trailing and locks at the starting balance. No daily loss limit. The 50% consistency rule and 5-day minimum apply on the evaluation; the funded PRO account switches to intraday drawdown with no consistency rule.

firms.name: Funded Trading Plus
firms.notes: Figures shown are for the 2-Step Classic account. There is no minimum-trading-days requirement, but a 3% per-symbol loss cap applies. The 1-Step model uses a 6% relative max / 4% daily with no consistency rule.

firms.name: Maven Trading
firms.notes: Figures shown are for the 1-Step Challenge; max drawdown is EOD trailing from the highest equity point. The 2-Step plans use 4% daily / 8% max. A 20% consistency rule applies only to Instant accounts.

firms.name: Bulenox
firms.notes: Figures shown are for the 50K account. Trailing drawdown updates in real time; the daily loss limit (where present) is a soft suspension, not a fail. The 40% consistency rule applies to payouts, and 10 trading days are required before the first payout on the funded Master account.
